id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the run this metric belongs to (matches runs.id).

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The project that the run belongs to (cloud only).

run_start_ns.title: Run Start Ns
run_start_ns.description: The timestamp of the start of the run in nanoseconds.

run_ns.title: Run Ns
run_ns.description: Total time for the run in nanoseconds.

num_steps.title: Num Steps
num_steps.description: The number of steps in the run.

tools_used.title: Tools Used
tools_used.description: List of tool IDs that were used in this run.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: The template ID that the run belongs to (cloud only).

base_template_id.title: Base Template Id
base_template_id.description: The base template ID that the run belongs to (cloud only).
